what: Thin bars are laid below the stacked panels (logos · photos), one per panel. When the current panel’s bar fills over 2s with no easing, the current panel slides to -30% while fading and the next panel enters from 30% in .8s power2.out (they overlap at the 60% point of the exit). Once a panel is at the center of the screen it starts from the beginning and loops endlessly

options.hold: Time for the bar to fill (s), default 2
options.dur: Time (s) for the panel to slide out and in, default .8
options.shift: Distance to drop out and come in (%), default 30
options.overlap: Position where the next panel starts coming in (% of the exit), default 60
options.start: Start position (ScrollTrigger start), default top center
options.look: light: On a dark panel — bars in a light color

use:
Panel 1
Panel 2
note: The panel’s parent (the frame holding the overlap) gets position: relative, overflow: hidden, and a height from the consumer. This part places the panels over each other with position: absolute
